verdict.rationale: Puzzle advertises a free migration from QuickBooks that it says loses no data ("without lifting a finger or losing your client's data"). For other source systems, its documented CSV bulk import of manual journal entries and chart-of-accounts upload give a path to bring over historical books. Missing for 10: first-party docs on how the migration works and how transaction-level detail is preserved, named support for systems other than QuickBooks (e.g. Xero), and independent or hands-on confirmation that migrated history keeps full detail.
